items.source: the added JsonWriter.Member which may be configured further
items.translation: 新增的JsonWriter.Member，可进一步配置。

items.source: name - the member name
Add the a JsonWriter.NameProcessor to be applied when the JSON is written.
items.translation: 添加一个JsonWriter.NameProcessor，以便在写入 JSON 时应用。

items.source: Add the a JsonWriter.ValueProcessor to be applied when the JSON is written.
items.translation: 添加一个JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，以便在写入 JSON 时应用。

items.source: Add a new member with access to the instance being written.
items.translation: 添加一个新成员，使其能够访问正在写入的实例。

items.source: extractor - JsonWriter.Extractor to extract the value
items.translation: `extractor` - JsonWriter.Extractor 用于提取值。

items.source: value - the member value
supplier - a supplier of the value
Members can filtered using Member.when methods and adapted to different types using Member.as(...).
items.translation: 成员可以使用 Member.when 方法进行过滤，并使用 Member.as(...) 适配为不同的类型。

items.source: Members can be added without a name when a Member.using(...) method is used to complete the definition.
items.translation: 当使用 Member.using(...) 方法完成定义时，可以在没有 name 的情况下添加成员。

items.source: Add all entries from the given Map to the JSON.
items.translation: 将给定Map中的所有条目添加到 JSON 中。

items.source: Add a new member with access to the instance being written. The member is added without a name, so one of the Member.using(...) methods must be used to complete the configuration.
items.translation: 添加一个新成员，使其能够访问正在写入的实例。该成员在添加时没有名称，因此必须使用其中一个 Member.using(...) 方法来完成配置。

items.source: Add members from a static value. One of the Member.using(...) methods must be used to complete the configuration.
items.translation: 从静态值添加成员。必须使用其中一个 Member.using(...) 方法来完成配置。

items.source: Add members from a supplied value. One of the Member.using(...) methods must be used to complete the configuration.
items.translation: 从提供的值添加成员。必须使用其中一个 Member.using(...) 方法来完成配置。

items.source: Add members from an extracted value. One of the Member.using(...) methods must be used to complete the configuration.
items.translation: 从提取的值添加成员。必须使用其中一个 Member.using(...) 方法来完成配置。

items.source: Add a new member with a static value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有静态值的新成员。

items.source: Add a new member with a supplied value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有指定值的新成员。

items.source: Add a new member with an extracted value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有提取值的新成员。

items.source: Add a filter that will be used to restrict the members written to the JSON.
items.translation: 添加一个过滤器，用于限制写入 JSON 的成员。

items.source: extractor - JsonWriter.Extractor to extract the map
items.translation: `extractor` - 使用JsonWriter.Extractor提取该 Map。

items.source: T - the type that will be written
V - the value type
V - the value type
V - the value type
M - the map type
K - the key type
V - the value type
V - the value type
V - the value type
V - the value type
predicate - the predicate used to filter members
nameProcessor - the name processor to add
valueProcessor - the value processor to add
Add members from a static value.
Add members from a supplied value.
Add members from an extracted value.
items.translation: 从提取的值中添加成员。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Moritz Halbritter
